subject: Scheduling: GreenLane demo — attendee conflict & compressed option
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: GreenLane demo — proposed time (Aug 6)

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the interest. Per our call last week, we'd like to lock in a demo to show the Redwood inference runtime with the GreenLane telemetry use case. Proposed time: Wednesday, Aug 6, 10:00–11:00 AM PT.

Planned attendees from Redwood: Marissa (AE), Karthik (SE), Vivek (Senior SE) and me. Would Priya and the exec stakeholders be available for that slot? If the VP prefers a shorter executive session, we can compress to a 30-minute leadership-focused overview and schedule a separate technical deep dive with your engineering team.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft), suggested-questions.txt

If you want a different time window, suggest two alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@greenlane.io>

Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenLane demo — proposed time (Aug 6)

Thanks, Stephanie — appreciate the quick follow-up.

Priya can join Aug 6 at 10:00 AM PT, but our exec slot is tight: we have an internal leadership sync that overruns frequently. Also, Marissa mentioned (offline) she may be onsite with another customer that morning — I don't want to force people into two meetings at once.

Would Redwood be able to run a compressed 30-minute exec-focused session (key outcomes, cost/latency overview, business impact) at 10:00–10:30, and then plan a separate 60–90 minute technical deep dive with SEs the following week? Our procurement team wants the exec alignment first so we can prioritize budget conversation.

If recording the exec portion is an option and the technical deep dive can be SE-only, that would also work for us.

—Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Platform Integrations, GreenLane Logistics
sam.torres@greenlane.io

- Do a focused 30-minute exec session 10:00–10:30 AM PT (high-level value props, pricing band, risk/compliance callouts). I can lead the AE portions and hand off technical Q&A to Karthik/Vivek for brief clarifying points.
- Schedule a separate technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) the week after (suggest Tue Aug 12 or Wed Aug 13). Karthik/Vivek will run that and we can invite your engineers.

I've attached a condensed agenda for the 30-minute session (agenda-compact-30m.pdf) and an updated mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with tentative follow-up dates.

If that works, Stephanie — can you update the invite and include a recording option? Sam / Priya — if you confirm attendees for the exec slot (names / titles) we'll lock it.

Thanks,
